tomas: quick ping — PR #2852 (compactifier) has two style nits from CI: a gofmt and a questionable var name in compact.go. Who can pick this up? Prefer to merge today if it goes green.
laura: I can take the var rename. which identifier is it?
tomas: it's the compactKV function. CI flagged naming and gofmt. snippet: ```- func compactKV(items []Item) { /*...*/ }``` seems like an initialism edgecase.
maya: Heads-up — our repo initialism rules are inconsistent. We usually keep common initialisms ALLCAPS (e.g., HTTP, ID) but some linters want CamelCase. If it's just gofmt + golangci-lint we should follow linter.
laura: I'll run `gofmt` and `golangci-lint run` locally and push a tiny fix (rename or adjust linter config). ping me if anyone objects to changing the identifier.
ryan: no objections from me for a tiny style fix. Please use commit message `style(compact): fix fmt and initialism` so changelog is clear.
ci-bot: buildkite/pr-2852: failing — gofmt check failed (1 file). see https://ci/build/2852 for logs.
laura: Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2852/commits/abc123 — includes gofmt and the rename to `compactKV` -> I kept KV uppercase per existing code patterns. Running CI.
ci-bot: buildkite/pr-2852: all checks passed ✅ (gofmt + golangci-lint)
maya: :thumbsup: LGTM from me. ryan, any merge objection?
ryan: none. small style-only change is fine. squash on merge please.
laura: merging now. /merge
mergebot: PR #2852 merged by laura into main (3701234567)
tomas: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround!
